lines.identification: Bright straight band about 510 m long, 205 m north of the castle's north edge, running from the middle town into the lower town. It matches the east-west street drawn across the middle town and lower town in Bisht 2015, Dholavira Report (preliminary, Jan 2015), Fig. 2.4 'Plan showing the various divisions of city of Dholavira' (PDF page 53), which lies about 210 m north of the castle, and is read as the excavated, cleared street surface.

lines.part: middle town (south side, on the ceremonial ground)
lines.identification: Bright band about 50 m north of the castle's north edge, west of the castle's north-east corner. In Bisht 2015, Dholavira Report (preliminary, Jan 2015), Fig. 2.4 'Plan showing the various divisions of city of Dholavira' (PDF page 53) the ceremonial ground lies between the castle and the middle town, about 50-60 m wide; the band is read as the middle town's southern wall or terrace edge along the north side of the ground. Bisht 2015, Fig. 6.1 'Plan of Dholavira showing the ratios and proportions' (PDF page 125) draws a grey dashed line in the same position.

Straight dark line about 330 m long at the boundary between the fields west of it and the bare mound east of it, about 160 m west of the castle's west side. Bisht 2015, Fig. 6.1 'Plan of Dholavira showing the ratios and proportions' (PDF page 125) and Bisht 2015, Dholavira Report (preliminary, Jan 2015), Fig. 2.4 'Plan showing the various divisions of city of Dholavira' (PDF page 53) place the middle town's west wall about 340 m west of its east wall, which lies close to the castle's east side, with cultivated ground between the middle town and the outer west wall; the line is read as the line of the middle town's west wall.

North edge of the bright excavated block, about 150 by 160 m, that lies south of the ceremonial ground with the bailey to its west, as the castle does in Bisht 2015, Dholavira Report (preliminary, Jan 2015), Fig. 2.4 'Plan showing the various divisions of city of Dholavira' (PDF page 53) and Bisht 2015, Fig. 6.1 'Plan of Dholavira showing the ratios and proportions' (PDF page 125); read as the outer face of the castle's north wall.
East edge of the same bright excavated block, read as the outer face of the castle's east wall (Bisht 2015, Fig. 6.1 'Plan of Dholavira showing the ratios and proportions' (PDF page 125)).
